mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(rsr.RSR_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS reservation_month, SUM( CASE WHEN r.discount_price IS NOT NULL THEN r.discount_price ELSE r.price END ) AS total_revenue FROM reservation rsr JOIN room r ON r.room_id = rsr.room_id JOIN ACCOMMODATION a ON a.acm_id = r.acm_id WHERE a.admin_id = #{admin_id} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(rsr.RSR_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY reservation_month

WITH date_range AS ( SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - LEVEL + 1 AS reservation_date FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) SELECT TO_CHAR(d.reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reservation_date, TO_CHAR(d.reservation_date, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') AS reservation_weekday, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN r.discount_price IS NOT NULL THEN r.discount_price ELSE r.price END), 0) AS total_revenue FROM date_range d LEFT JOIN reservation rsr ON TRUNC(rsr.RSR_DATE) = d.reservation_date LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = rsr.room_id GROUP BY d.reservation_date, TO_CHAR(d.reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_CHAR(d.reservation_date, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') ORDER BY CASE TO_CHAR(d.reservation_date, 'D') WHEN '2' THEN 1 -- 월요일 WHEN '3' THEN 2 -- 화요일 WHEN '4' THEN 3 -- 수요일 WHEN '5' THEN 4 -- 목요일 WHEN '6' THEN 5 -- 금요일 WHEN '7' THEN 6 -- 토요일 WHEN '1' THEN 7 -- 일요일 END, d.reservation_date

SELECT acct.ACM_TYPE acm_type, SUM(CASE WHEN r.discount_price IS NOT NULL THEN r.discount_price ELSE r.price END) AS total_revenue FROM ACCOMMODATION acc JOIN ACCOMMODATION_TYPE acct ON acc.ACM_TYPE_ID = acct.ACM_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN ROOM r ON r.ACM_ID = acc.ACM_ID LEFT JOIN reservation rsr ON rsr.room_id = r.room_id WHERE rsr.rsr_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY acct.ACM_TYPE
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_reservation_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN rsr.RSR_STATUS = '예약취소' THEN 1 END) AS cancellation_count FROM reservation rsr JOIN room r ON r.room_id = rsr.room_id

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE join_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND join_date < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)) AS newMemberCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS totalMemberCnt FROM DUAL

SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.ACM_NAME ACM_NAME, SUM( CASE WHEN r.discount_price IS NOT NULL THEN r.discount_price ELSE r.price END ) AS total_revenue FROM reservation rsr JOIN room r ON r.room_id = rsr.room_id LEFT JOIN ACCOMMODATION a ON r.acm_id = a.acm_id GROUP BY ACM_NAME ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3
